spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (दुःखयति)
To give pain.

n. (-खं)
1 Pain, sorrow, affliction, distress, unhappiness.
2 The world.
3 Difficulty, trouble.
E.
दुःख to give pain, affix अच्; or दु bad, and ख्या to call; or खन to dig, ड aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Causing pain.
2 Afflicting, occasioning sorrow or trouble.
E.
दुःख, and कर what makes.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Cut with difficulty, tough, hard.
2 Afflicted, pained, distressed.
E.
दुःख, and छिन्न cut.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 To be cut with difficulty, tough, hard.
2 To be overcome with difficulty.
3 To be hart or pained by, (affliction, &c.)
E.
दुःख, and छेद्य to be cut.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Living in pain or distress.
E.
दुःख, and जीविन् living.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Afflicted, pained, distressed.
E.
दुःख, and दग्ध burnt.

f. (-ह्या)
A cow difficult to be milked.
E.
दुःख trouble, दोह्य to be milked.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Full of trouble or pain.
E.
दुःख, and प्राय abundant.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Painful, distressful, abounding with trouble, &c.
E.
दुःख, and बहुल much.

mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि)
Suffering pain, having pain as their portion.
E.
दुःख, and भागिन् who shares.

m. (-गः)
Occurrence or incidence of trouble, pain, &c.
E.
दुःख, and योग union.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
To be obtained or effected with difficulty.
E.
दुःख, and लभ्य obtainable.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reared with trouble and difficulty.
E.
दुःस्व, and संवर्द्धित raised.

m. (-गः)
Accession or presence of pain, distress, &c.
E.
दुःख, and संयोग union.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Wretched, poor, miserable.
E.
दुःख, and संस्थिति condition.

m. (-रः)
1 Deep distress.
2 The world.
E.
दुःख, and सागर an ocean.

mfn. (-हा-हा-ह)
Removing pain.
E.
दुःख, and हन् who or what destroys.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Freed from pain.
E.
दुःख, and अतीत passed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pained, afflicted, distressed.
E.
दुःख, and अन्वित having.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Afflicted, pained, distressed.
E.
दुःख, and आर्त्त pained.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pained, suffering pain.
n. (-तं)
Pain, distress, trouble.
E.
दुःख to give pain, affix क्त.

mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि)
1 Suffering pain, sorrowing, afflicted.
2 Difficult, painful.
E.
दुःख, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suffering distress, &c.
E.
दुःख, and उपेत gone to.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Difficult of attainment.
E.
दुर्, and प्राप obtaining; also दुष्प्राप.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
Difficult of attainment.
E.
दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable: also दुष्प्राप्य.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Ungovernable, ill managed, intractable.
E.
दुर्, and शासन an edict.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Ill behaved, reprobate, abandoned.
E.
दुर्, and शील behaviour.

ind.
Improperly, unseasonably, unfitly.
E.
दुर् bad, सम् equal to; स changed to ष.

m. (-तिः)
A wicked son.
E.
दुर्, सूति progeny.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Not coherent, difficult to be united or joined.
E.
दुर्, and सन्धान uniting.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Improper, unseasonable.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, सम same.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Intolerable, difficult to be borne.
E.
दुर्, and सह what is borne.

m. (-धी)
A porter, a warder.
E.
दुर् ill, साध to accomplish, affix णिनि.

mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं)
1 Difficult, arduous, not easily accomplished.
2 Incurable or difficult of cure.
E.
दुर् ill, साध to accomplish, affix यत्.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Poor, ill conditioned, badly situated.
2 Ignorant, unwise, a fool.
3 Suffering pain or affliction, distressed, unhappy.
4 Covetous.
m. (-स्थः)
Pain, trouble.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, स्था to be or exist, affix ड.

f. (-तिः)
1 Unsteadiness, instability.
2 Unhappiness, ill fortune or condition.
E.
दुर् bad, &c. स्थिति staying, state.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Difficult or unfit to be touched.
m. (-र्शः)
A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
f. (-र्शा)
A prickly sort of nightshade.
E.
दुर् bad, स्पृश to touch, affix खल्, fem. affix टाप्.

m. (-टः)
A sort of weapon.
E.
दुर् ill, स्फुट to bear, affix अच्.
